overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（9 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（1 篇）、劳动经济学（1 篇）。方法上以调查数据、深度学习为主。来源分布：OpenAlex（6 篇）、arXiv（5 篇）、Semantic Scholar（1 篇）。

papers.title: Food Sovereignty in an Age of Geopolitical Fragmentation: Corporate Power, Global Supply-Chain Vulnerabilities, and the Reconfiguration of Indonesia’s National Food Politics
papers.venue: Journal on Political Sciences & International Relations
papers.abstract: Global  food  politics  connects  agrifood  production  and  consumption  to  geopolitical  conflict,  corporate  concentration,  trade  governance,  climate  instability, and contested claims over food sovereignty. This qualitative literature review examines how those transnational forces influence Indonesia’s national food-policy orientation, especially its renewed emphasis on domestic production, public reserves, postharvest infrastructure, price stabilization, and village cooperatives. Drawing interpretively on peer-reviewed journal literature published during 2020–2026 and triangulating policy claims against official Indonesian regulations, the review identifies seven interconnected arenas of power: knowledge and seed technologies; agricultural inputs; trade and logistics; finance and corporate organization; rule-setting; narratives and information; and land, procurement, and territorial distribution. Findings indicate that external shocks expose real vulnerabilities, but neither autarky nor indiscriminate import liberalization provides a sufficient response. Indonesia’s institutional challenge is to combine domestic productive capacity with diversified external sourcing, accessible nutritious diets, protected smallholder livelihoods, accountable reserves, ecological safeguards, and meaningful local participation. The review develops a conditional-sovereignty framework that treats autonomy as an ability to make effective, equitable choices under uncertainty rather than as the elimination of trade. It proposes a multidimensional policy scorecard and a research agenda for testing implementation outcomes. The principal contribution is a critical synthesis linking international political economy to Indonesia’s concrete food-governance instruments while distinguishing verified legal intent from outcomes that still require empirical evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】全球粮食政治将农业食品的生产与消费与地缘政治冲突、企业集中化、贸易治理、气候不稳定以及对粮食主权的争议性主张联系在一起。这篇定性文献综述探讨了这些跨国力量如何影响印度尼西亚的国家粮食政策导向，尤其是其重新强调国内生产、公共储备、产后基础设施、价格稳定以及农村合作社等方面。通过分析2020至2026年间发表的同行评审期刊文献，并将政策主张与印度尼西亚的官方法规进行对比，该综述确定了七个相互关联的权力领域：知识与种子技术；农业投入；贸易与物流；金融与企业组织；规则制定；叙事与信息；以及土地、采购和领土分配。研究结果表明，外部冲击暴露了印度尼西亚的脆弱性，但无论是自给自足还是无差别的进口自由化都无法提供足够的应对措施。印度尼西亚面临的制度挑战在于如何将国内生产能力与多元化的外部资源、可获得的营养饮食、对小农生计的保护、生态保障措施以及有意义的本地参与结合起来。该综述提出了一个“有条件主权”的框架，将自主性视为在不确定性条件下做出有效、公平决策的能力，而非完全消除贸易。它还提出了一种多维度的政策评估指标体系，并为检验政策实施效果制定了研究议程。本文的主要贡献在于将国际政治经济学与印度尼西...。

papers.title: Identifying dynamical network markers of financial market instability
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Market instability has been extensively studied using mathematical approaches to characterize complex trading dynamics and detect structural change points. This study explores the potential for early detection of market instability by applying the Dynamical Network Markers (DNM) theory to order placement and execution data from the Tokyo Stock Exchange. DNM theory identifies indicators associated with critical transitions as their precursors in high-dimensional financial market systems of many interacting elements. In this study, market participants are identified using virtual server IDs from the trading system, and multivariate time series representing their trading activities are constructed. This framework treats each participant as an interacting element, thereby enabling the application of DNM theory to the obtained time series. The results indicate the presence of DNM-related patterns associated with large price movements on a daily time scale. These findings demonstrate the applicability of the DNM framework to market participant behavioral data and provide a basis for understanding mechanisms of instabilizing dynamics in financial market systems. The study could inform potential future developments of DNM-based early warning indicators through the identification of appropriate forecasting horizons and time scales as well as the incorporation of multiple aspects of trading behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
市场不稳定现象已通过数学方法得到广泛研究，这些方法用于刻画复杂的交易动态并检测结构变化点。本研究探讨了通过将动态网络标记（Dynamical Network Markers, DNM）理论应用于东京证券交易所的订单下达与执行数据，来实现对市场不稳定性的早期检测的可能性。DNM理论能够识别出与关键转变相关的指标，这些指标是高度复杂、由众多相互作用元素构成的金融市场系统中的前兆信号。在本研究中，市场参与者通过交易系统中的虚拟服务器ID进行识别，并构建了代表其交易活动的多变量时间序列。该框架将每个参与者视为一个相互作用元素，从而可以将DNM理论应用于所获得的时间序列数据中。研究结果表明，在日时间尺度上存在与价格大幅波动相关的DNM相关模式。这些发现证明了DNM框架在分析市场参与者行为数据方面的适用性，并为理解金融市场系统中的不稳定动态机制提供了基础。本研究可为未来基于DNM的早期预警指标的开发提供参考，包括确定合适的预测范围和时间尺度，以及整合交易行为的多个方面。。研究方法：时间序列。

papers.title: Unequal Rewards and the Direction of Scientific Work: Evidence from U.S. Public Universities
papers.abstract: Research on pay dispersion has long asked whether unequal rewards increase or depress performance. Tournament theory expects stronger effort, while social comparison accounts expect withdrawal. Both perspectives, however, treat performance as a single scale on which workers can be ranked. Scientific work often resists such ordering. Some contributions extend recognized lines of inquiry and can be evaluated against prevailing standards; others revise the frames through which value is judged and become legible only later. We argue that intellectual tournaments more readily reward the first kind of contribution than the second. Pay dispersion may therefore be associated not only with how much scholars produce but also with what kinds of intellectual exploration are encouraged. We test this argument with administrative payroll records for 105,050 tenure-line faculty in 4,839 departments at 93 U.S. public universities from 2004 to 2026, linked to publication histories in OpenAlex. For each department, we estimate a separate pay equation using rank, contract basis, and seniority, then measure the Gini of the salary variation this local ladder cannot explain. Scholars in departments with greater unexplained pay dispersion publish more papers and receive more citations, but their work is less disruptive, less novel, and more conventional. Additional analyses show that compensation premiums above the ladder go disproportionately to scholars with broad collaborations and topical breadth. Although the design cannot fully separate treatment from selection, the evidence shows that inequality is not only a distributional outcome but also an evaluative structure, shaping which forms of knowledge are recognized, rewarded, and reproduced within organizations and communities.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】关于薪酬差异的研究长期以来一直在探讨：不平等的报酬是会提升还是抑制绩效。锦标赛理论认为这会激发更强的工作积极性，而社会比较理论则认为这可能导致员工产生消极情绪（如退出工作）。然而，这两种观点都将绩效视为一个可以用来对员工进行排序的单一标准。但科学研究往往并不遵循这种简单的排序方式。一些研究在现有研究基础上进行了拓展，并能够根据现有标准进行评估；另一些研究则重新定义了价值评判的框架，其意义需要更长时间才能被理解。我们认为，在知识竞赛中，第一种类型的贡献（即具有创新性和颠覆性的贡献）更有可能获得奖励。因此，薪酬差异不仅可能与学者的产出量有关，还可能与他们所从事的知识探索类型有关。为了验证这一观点，我们使用了2004年至2026年间美国93所公立大学4,839个院系中105,050名终身教职员工的行政薪资记录，这些数据与OpenAlex平台上的学术发表记录进行了关联分析。对于每个院系，我们分别根据员工的排名、合同类型和资历来估算薪酬模型，然后计算出该模型无法解释的薪资差异的基尼系数（即薪酬分布的不平等程度）。那些所在院系薪酬差异较大的学者发表了更多论文，也获得了更多引用，但他们的工作创...。

papers.title: Price co-movement and price information diverge across Nordic electricity zones after the energy crisis
papers.abstract: After the 2021-2022 energy crisis, day-ahead prices in Nordic bidding zones no longer move together. We ask whether this divergence also changes the information carried by prices. The answer matters for integrating variable renewable energy (VRE), because it can help identify where wind and solar forecasts are worth producing, publishing, and using. We measured the co-movement of each Norwegian and Swedish zone with Germany-Luxembourg (DE-LU) in 2018-2025. We then used a single model, selected on 2024 data, to forecast 2025 prices at 11:00 on the previous day and tested which inputs improved accuracy in each zone. The zones moved alike until 2019, but co-movement diverged in Sweden in 2020 and in Norway in 2021, and the split has persisted. In 2024, four southern zones co-moved strongly with DE-LU (intraday correlations of 0.54-0.71), while four northern zones co-moved weakly (0.25-0.30). Yet price information did not follow this split. Previous-day neighbouring prices reduced mean absolute error by at most 2.2% in any zone, equally in coupled and isolated zones. Removing the transmission system operators' wind and solar forecasts increased mean absolute error by at most 6% in Norway, 8-16% in Sweden, and 31% in DE-LU, and the ordering held in 2024. Within Norway, the value of these forecasts showed no detectable dependence on reservoir filling. The divergence in co-movement was therefore not matched by a divergence in price information, which differed mainly between national generation systems. Thus, a zone's coupling to the continent does not indicate the value of VRE forecasts there.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】2021-2022年能源危机之后，北欧地区的日前电价不再同步波动。我们探讨这种价格差异是否也改变了电价所传递的信息。这一现象对于整合可变可再生能源（VRE）具有重要意义，因为它有助于确定风能和太阳能发电的可行性以及这些能源信息的发布和利用价值。我们分析了2018-2025年间挪威和瑞典各区域与德国-卢森堡（DE-LU）地区之间的价格联动情况，并基于2024年的数据建立了一个预测模型，用于预测次日上午11点的电价。结果显示：各区域在2019年之前价格波动趋势一致，但2020年瑞典地区、2021年挪威地区的价格联动性开始出现分化，且这种分化持续至今。2024年，挪威南部四个区域与DE-LU地区的价格联动性较强（日内相关性为0.54-0.71），而北部四个区域的价格联动性较弱（0.25-0.30）。然而，电价信息并未反映出这种区域差异。无论区域是否与外部市场相连，前一天的邻近地区电价对预测误差的降低幅度最多仅为2.2%。当剔除输电系统运营商提供的风能和太阳能发电预测数据后，挪威地区的预测误差增加了最多6%，瑞典地区增加了8-16%，DE-LU地区增加了31%，且这种差异在2024年依然...。

papers.title: Contingent convertible bonds (CoCo): impact on shareholder wealth dilution and risk management
papers.venue: Journal of Economics Finance and Administrative Science
papers.abstract:
This article investigates how the capital structure of a bank financed by equity, conventional bonds, contingent convertible (CoCo) bonds, and deposits is affected by the dilution of shareholders' wealth. Capital dilution results from the conversion of CoCo bonds into a predetermined number of shares when a particular leverage ratio threshold is reached.
 
 
 
 An analytical formula was developed for the values of CoCo and conventional bonds by combining two European barrier call options used to conceptualize shareholder value. The proportion of shares held by current shareholders and the fraction held by investors who converted their securities into shares are expressed precisely in order to examine the dilution issue.
 
 
 
 Numerical evaluations indicate that CoCo bonds generally enhance shareholder wealth by lowering bankruptcy risks, until the dilution effect counterbalances this advantage.
 
 
 
 The results presented in this paper can offer various benefits to banks, investors, and regulators. First, leverage ratios are used to trigger equity conversion, rather than conventional capital ratios. Second, the results support the notion that CoCo bonds boost both shareholder wealth and bank value by reducing the likelihood of costly bankruptcies. Finally, the research emphasizes the importance of selecting appropriate parameters when structuring CoCo bonds.
 
 
 
 The results provide evidence that CoCo bonds improve bank value and shareholder wealth by reducing default risk, enhancing financial stability and bank soundness, and increasing shareholder wealth through reduced bankruptcy risk.
papers.summary_zh:
【风险管理与衍生品】本文研究了银行的资本结构（包括股权融资、传统债券、可转换债券（CoCo债券）和存款）如何受到股东财富稀释的影响。当杠杆比率达到特定阈值时，CoCo债券会转换为预定数量的股票，从而导致股东财富的稀释。

为了计算CoCo债券和传统债券的价值，本文结合了两种欧式障碍看涨期权来构建分析模型，这些期权用于量化股东价值。文中精确地表达了现有股东持有的股票比例以及将证券转换为股票的投资者所持有的股票比例，以便深入分析财富稀释问题。

数值模拟结果表明，在破产风险降低的情况下，CoCo债券通常能够提升股东财富；然而，当稀释效应抵消这一优势时，其积极作用便会减弱。

本文的研究结果对银行、投资者和监管机构具有多重意义：首先，杠杆比率被用作触发股权转换的依据，而非传统的资本比率；其次，研究结果证实CoCo债券通过降低破产风险，有效提升了股东财富和银行价值；最后，研究强调了在设计CoCo债券结构时选择合适参数的重要性。

研究证据表明，CoCo债券通过降低违约风险、增强财务稳定性和银行稳健性，以及减少破产风险来提升银行价值和股东财富。。

papers.title: Nonconviction Arrests and Labor Market Trajectories
papers.venue: Journal of Economics Race and Policy
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  In this Article, I examine whether nonconviction arrests—one of the least severe forms of formal criminal justice contact—destabilize labor market trajectories. Using longitudinal data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997 (NLSY97) and individual fixed-effects models, I isolate the relationship between nonconviction arrests and labor market outcomes among adult men. I find that a nonconviction arrest is associated with a 7.5% point increase in the likelihood of employment disruption in the following survey period. In the longer term, nonconviction arrests are associated with hourly wages that are approximately 10.5% lower and significant reductions in access to employer-provided health insurance (5.1% points) and retirement benefits (8.7% points). Reduced access to benefits appears to be related to lower rates of full-time employment. Given Black men’s disproportionate exposure to nonconviction arrest, these findings suggest that arrest practices may contribute to racial disparities in labor market outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
【劳动经济学】摘要  
本文探讨了非定罪逮捕（即最轻微形式的正式刑事司法干预）是否会对劳动市场轨迹产生负面影响。通过使用1997年全国青少年纵向调查（NLSY97）的纵向数据及个体固定效应模型，我分析了非定罪逮捕与成年男性劳动市场结果之间的关系。研究发现，非定罪逮捕会使得个体在后续调查期间遭遇就业中断的概率增加7.5个百分点。从长期来看，非定罪逮捕会导致每小时工资降低约10.5%，同时显著减少获得雇主提供的健康保险（降低5.1个百分点）和退休福利（降低8.7个百分点）的机会。福利获取的减少似乎与全职就业率的下降有关。鉴于黑人男性更容易遭受非定罪逮捕，这些发现表明逮捕行为可能加剧了劳动市场中的种族差异。。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: A UAV-based real-time detection system of flowering nectar plants using a lightweight deep learning model
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Purpose
                    
                      Timely knowledge of flowering status and peak blooming periods in transferred areas is crucial for migratory beekeepers to make informed management decisions. Traditional manual field surveys are labor-intensive, time-consuming, and unsuitable for frequent monitoring. Current monitoring approaches using Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) rely on offline processing and require complex data analysis by specialists, making them impractical for beekeepers to implement in apicultural settings. Given the short time window for capturing flowering events, especially for species with short florescence periods, an accurate, fast monitoring solution is needed. We developed a UAV-based real-time investigation prototype leveraging edge-intelligence computing for nectar flower detection of
                      Rhus chinensis
                      in complex mountainous field conditions.
                    
                  
                  
                    Methods
                    An improved, high-precision, and lightweight deep learning model based on YOLOv5s was proposed. The model was optimized with acceleration strategies during deployment to reduce inference time.
                  
                  
                    Results
                    Experimental results showed that the proposed model for flower detection achieved a mean Average Precision (mAP) of 89.5 and an inference speed of 56 frames per second (FPS). After applying acceleration strategies during model deployment on the edge computing device, the processing throughput reached 192 FPS with a mAP of 89.2; a 3.1% increase in mAP and approximately a 5.6 times improvement in FPS compared to the original YOLOv5s.
                  
                  
                    Conclusions
                    These results demonstrate that the proposed lightweight model and acceleration strategies effectively balance high accuracy with high-throughput onboard image processing. The developed UAV-edge computing system provides a promising prototype for future efficient nectar flowering status monitoring, with potential applications in smart apiculture.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要

目的

对于迁徙养蜂人而言，及时了解移植区域的开花状况和高峰开花期对于做出明智的管理决策至关重要。传统的人工野外调查工作耗时费力，且不适合频繁进行监测。目前使用无人机（UAV）的监测方法依赖于离线处理，需要专业人员进行复杂的数据分析，因此对于养蜂人来说在实际应用中并不实用。鉴于捕捉开花事件的时间窗口非常短暂，尤其是对于开花期较短的物种而言，亟需一种准确、快速的监测解决方案。我们开发了一种基于无人机的实时监测原型系统，该系统利用边缘计算技术，在复杂的山区环境中实现对中华沙棘（Rhus chinensis）花蜜花朵的检测。

方法

我们提出了一种改进型的高精度、轻量级深度学习模型，该模型基于YOLOv5s框架构建，并在部署过程中采用了加速策略以减少推理时间。

结果

实验结果表明，所提出的花朵检测模型平均精度（mAP）达到了89.5%，推理速度为每秒56帧（FPS）。在边缘计算设备上应用加速策略后，处理吞吐量提升至每秒192帧，平均精度仍保持在89.2%；与原始的YOLOv5s相比，平均精度提高了3.1%，推理速度提高了约5.6倍。

结论

papers.title: Profitability and net greenhouse gas balances in pasture-based dairy systems: an exploratory case study of twelve South African farms
papers.abstract:
Using net greenhouse gas (GHG) balances from the DESTiny biogenic carbon model (
                    https://assetresearch.org.za/on-farm-carbon-capture-and-storage-capacity/
                    ) together with detailed farm financial accounts, this exploratory case study examines how profitability and net GHG balance co-vary on twelve pasture-based dairy farms in the Garden Route region of South Africa. Net GHG balances, the annual net flux of emissions and removals within the farm boundary, include enteric methane, manure, soil N₂O, emissions from on-farm energy use and purchased inputs, and net biogenic carbon fluxes. Eleven of the twelve farms achieved net GHG removals (a negative net GHG balance) and all farms were profitable, with mean net profits (before carbon valuation) of USD0.39 kg
                    −1
                    fat- and protein-corrected milk (FPCM), USD6,331 ha
                    −1
                    and USD2,105 LSU
                    −1
                    , and mean net GHG balances of −0.95 kg CO₂e kg
                    −1
                    FPCM, −14.4 t CO₂e ha
                    −1
                    and −4.71 t CO₂e LSU
                    −1
                    . Profit per hectare was negatively associated with net GHG per hectare (Spearman ρ = −0.70,
                    p
                     = 0.011), and this association remained when the only net-source farm was excluded (ρ = −0.66,
                    p
                     = 0.026). Associations per kg FPCM (ρ = −0.31) and per LSU (ρ = −0.34) were weak and not statistically significant. Valuing the net GHG balance at the South African carbon tax rate (R190, about USD25.7 t
                    −1
                    CO₂e) strengthened all three associations, and at USD100 t
                    −1
                    CO₂e the per-kg association became significant (ρ = −0.76,
                    p
                     = 0.004). Farms that combined high profit per hectare with large net removals typically had high forage yields, a large share of the forage area under no-tillage, moderate synthetic nitrogen use and a feed-sourcing strategy that balanced self-produced forage with purchased concentrates. The results are descriptive and specific to this sample, but they suggest that, once biogenic carbon removals are accounted for, land-efficient management in pasture-based dairy systems can go together with both profitability and larger net removals, and that valuing the modelled net GHG balance at a carbon price would reinforce this alignment at the product level. The net GHG balances are modelled annual flows, not measured changes in carbon stocks, and the carbon valuation is a hypothetical shadow price, not marketable carbon.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】本研究采用DESTiny生物碳模型（https://assetresearch.org.za/on-farm-carbon-capture-and-storage-capacity/）提供的净温室气体（GHG）平衡数据，结合详细的农场财务账目，探讨了南非Garden Route地区12个以牧场为基础的奶牛场的盈利能力与净温室气体平衡之间的关系。净温室气体平衡是指农场边界内的年度净排放量与净吸收量之和，包括肠道甲烷排放、粪便产生的氮氧化物（N₂O）、农场能源使用及购买投入品的排放，以及生物碳的净流动。其中11个农场实现了净温室气体吸收（即净温室气体平衡为负值），所有农场均实现了盈利，平均净利润（未考虑碳价值）分别为每公斤脂肪和蛋白质校正牛奶（FPCM）0.39美元、每公顷6,331美元以及每公顷2,105兰特；平均净温室气体平衡分别为每公斤FPCM -0.95千克二氧化碳当量（CO₂e）、每公顷-14.4吨二氧化碳当量以及每公顷-4.71吨二氧化碳当量。每公顷利润与每公顷净温室气体排放量呈负相关（Spearman相关系数ρ = -0.70，p = 0.011），即使排除唯一一个净温...。

papers.title: SQCDL-WIoT: a scalable quantum convolutional deep learning framework with wearable IoT integration for breast cancer screening
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Deep learning techniques have greatly improved the ability to perform automatic diagnosis of breast cancer through use of computers; however, existing techniques are generally complex and costly, do not well incorporate multiple data modalities, and cannot be deployed clinically in real time. This paper proposes SQCDL-WIoT, which is a scalable, wearable-based internet of things (IoT)-enabled quantum convolutional deep learning (C-DL) framework capable of multi-class breast cancer screening. The proposed method includes two VQCs with five qubits each that can be embedded into a ResNet-50 back bone. In addition to being able to process images from histopathology and wearable-based bio sensor signals as input, the method also enables the incorporation of both wearable based bio sensor signal processing (i.e., wearable-IoT) and clinical variables via the Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) attention mechanism. Thus, this proposed method is capable of hybrid quantum-classical training. Using stratified k-folds cross-validation (where k = 5) on the BreaKHis dataset and zero-shot transfer learning on the CBIS-DDSM dataset, SQCDL-WIoT demonstrated the highest accuracy (98.14%) with the highest sensitivity (macro-sensitivity = 97.63%), specificity (macro-specificity = 98.87%), and area under curve (AUC = 0.9891) when compared to all other baseline methods at 40x magnification on BreaKHis. Additionally, SQCDL-WIoT demonstrated 93.41% accuracy on the CBIS-DDSM dataset via zero shot learning, indicating good cross-domain generalization. Finally, the wearable IoT sub-system demonstrated a mean real-time edge-inference latency of 378 ± 12 milliseconds on an ARM Cortex-A72 processor, meeting the defined clinical threshold for response of < 400 milliseconds. The results of ablation studies indicated that both quantum convolution and SE attention contributed to complementary and synergetic increases in performance compared to classical ResNet-50 baseline models. Overall, the collective results presented here indicate that the proposed hybrid quantum-classical DL framework combined with wearable-based IoT sensing may represent a viable solution to scalable and intelligent breast cancer screening.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
深度学习技术显著提升了计算机在乳腺癌自动诊断方面的能力；然而，现有技术通常较为复杂且成本较高，难以有效整合多种数据模式，也无法实现实时临床应用。本文提出了一种名为SQCDL-WIoT的可扩展、基于可穿戴设备的物联网（IoT）支持的量子卷积深度学习（C-DL）框架，该框架能够实现多类别乳腺癌筛查。该方案包含两个各包含五个量子比特（qubit）的量子卷积层（VQCs），这些层可嵌入到ResNet-50神经网络结构中。除了能够处理来自组织病理学的图像和基于可穿戴设备的生物传感器信号外，该框架还通过“挤压-激励”（Squeeze-and-Excitation, SE）注意力机制实现了对可穿戴生物传感器信号处理数据以及临床变量的整合，从而支持混合量子-经典训练方式。在BreaKHis数据集上采用分层k折交叉验证（k=5）进行测试，并在CBIS-DDSM数据集上进行零样本迁移学习后，SQCDL-WIoT表现出最高的准确率（98.14%）、最高的灵敏度（宏观灵敏度97.63%）、最高的特异性（宏观特异性98.87%）以及最佳的曲线下面积（AUC=0.9891），其性能远超其他基线方法...。研究方法：深度学习。

papers.title: Uniform Inference for Two-Way Clustered Data
papers.abstract: We establish uniformly asymptotically exact inference for the population mean of two-way clustered data, allowing the data-generating process to vary with sample size. This finding does not contradict the well-known impossibility result of Menzel (2021), which places a fundamental limit on uniform estimation of the asymptotic distribution of the normalized full-array mean. We estimate the same population mean by averaging the sample means from random matchings. A closed-form standard error makes the resulting confidence interval straightforward to implement. The variance estimator is positive semidefinite and the studentized matching estimator is uniformly asymptotically standard normal. The cost of uniform validity is a slower convergence rate under degeneracy. We extend the result to smooth functions of GMM parameters, allowing the different moment components to exhibit different dependence regimes. In simulations, the proposed confidence intervals achieve coverage close to the nominal level across the dependence regimes considered.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们为双向聚类数据的总体均值建立了均匀渐近精确推断方法，该方法允许数据生成过程随样本量的变化而变化。这一发现并不与Menzel（2021年）提出的著名结论相矛盾，该结论指出了对标准化全阵列均值的渐近分布进行均匀估计的根本性限制。我们通过随机匹配得到的样本均值来估计相同的总体均值。由于存在封闭形式的标准误差，因此所得置信区间的计算非常直观。方差估计量是半正定的，而经过学生化处理的匹配估计量则具有均匀渐近正态分布特性。然而，这种均匀有效性的代价是在数据退化情况下收敛速度变慢。我们将这一结果扩展到了广义矩（GMM）参数的平滑函数情况，允许不同的矩分量表现出不同的依赖性特征。在模拟实验中，所提出的置信区间在考虑的各种依赖性条件下均能达到接近名义水平的覆盖率。。研究方法：匹配估计量、广义矩估计、数值模拟。

papers.title: Localizing Mean Shifts in High-Dimensional Vector Autoregressive Models
papers.abstract: We study the localization of mean changes in high-dimensional vector autoregressions (VARs) when the autoregressive dynamics remain common across regimes. We develop a three-step procedure that first obtains preliminary change-point estimates from the raw series ignoring the dependence structure, then estimates a common sparse VAR using observations away from the estimated changes, and finally filters the series to refine the change point locations.   For a single change point, we show that the preliminary localization rate depends directly on the strength of temporal dependence, whereas filtering removes this dependence penalty from the oracle rate. With an estimated filter, the refined rate additionally reflects the error in estimating the VAR dynamics and the relation between the change in the stationary mean and the corresponding change in the VAR intercept. We characterize these rates explicitly and establish conditions under which filtering improves localization. Because filtering near a change point uses lags from adjacent regimes, it also creates a short-lived distortion in the filtered mean; we characterize when this boundary effect is innocuous and develop a transition-corrected alternative.   We extend the procedure to an unknown number of change points. Overlapping local windows are used to generate candidate locations, an information criterion removes redundant and spurious candidates and estimates the number of changes, and the retained locations are subsequently refined using the estimated VAR filter. We establish consistency for the estimated number of changes and simultaneous localization rates for their locations. Numerical experiments corroborate the localization gains and show robustness to moderate departures from common VAR dynamics. An application to a large panel of U.S. macroeconomic indicators identifies economically interpretable changes.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在高维向量自回归（VAR）模型中，当自回归动态在不同经济制度下保持一致时，均值变化的定位问题。我们提出了一种三步法：首先忽略序列的依赖结构，从原始数据中初步估计变化点位置；其次利用变化点之外的观测值估计一个共同的、结构简化的VAR模型；最后通过滤波处理来精确定位变化点的具体位置。对于单个变化点，我们发现初步的定位精度直接取决于时间依赖性的强弱，而滤波过程能够消除这种依赖性对定位精度的影响。使用经过优化的滤波器后，定位精度还能进一步反映VAR动态估计的误差，以及稳态均值变化与VAR模型截距变化之间的关系。我们明确描述了这些定位精度指标，并确定了在何种条件下滤波能够提升定位效果。由于在变化点附近进行滤波会使用相邻经济制度下的数据，因此可能会导致滤波后均值出现短暂失真；我们分析了这种边界效应何时可以忽略，并提出了一种经过修正的算法。该方法可扩展到存在多个变化点的情况：通过设置重叠的局部窗口生成候选变化点位置，利用信息准则筛选掉冗余或虚假的候选点，并估计实际的变化点数量；最后利用优化的VAR滤波器对候选位置进行精确定位。我们证明了该方法在估计变化点数量及其位置方面的稳定性。数值...。研究方法：向量自回归、回归分析、实验方法。

papers.title: Dynamic Scenario-Based Portfolio Optimization for Multi-Asset ETFs
papers.abstract: Portfolio outcomes may depend as much on trading restrictions as on how returns are modeled. We compared historical moving-window returns with conditional scenarios from ARMA--GARCH models and a Student-$t$ copula for 30 U.S.-listed exchange-traded funds. Matched mean--variance and conditional value-at-risk portfolios were evaluated under long-only and limited long--short bounds over 946 sessions. Historical portfolios had higher observed reward--risk ratios in most comparisons, but no paired difference remained significant after multiple-testing adjustment. Conditional scenarios did not consistently reduce realized downside risk. We distinguished changes in target weights from trades required to rebalance holdings after market movements. Relaxing the target-adjustment limit changed exposures, turnover, and some returns more than varying scenario count or seed in the examined tests. These findings suggest that assessments of conditional return inputs should consider portfolio constraints and trading requirements.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】投资组合的收益可能既受回报建模方式的影响，也受交易限制的制约。我们对比了30只美国上市交易型基金的历史移动窗口回报数据，以及基于ARMA-GARCH模型和学生t分布的conditional scenarios（条件情景）预测结果。在946个交易时段内，我们评估了在仅允许多头交易（long-only）和有限的多头-空头交易（limited long-short）限制下的匹配均值-方差（matched mean-variance）投资组合和条件风险价值（conditional value-at-risk）投资组合的表现。在大多数比较中，历史投资组合的收益风险比更高；但在经过多重检验调整后，这些差异不再具有显著性。条件情景并未始终能够有效降低实际发生的下行风险。我们区分了目标权重变化与市场波动后为重新平衡持仓而进行的交易行为。研究发现，放宽目标权重调整限制会对投资组合的敞口、交易频率及某些回报产生比改变情景数量或初始设定更显著的影响。这些结果表明，在评估条件回报预测模型时，应充分考虑投资组合的约束条件和交易规则。。研究方法：GARCH 波动率模型。
